$meta.name: Sterling
$meta.description: Source of truth for Sterling. Aliases use {collection-local variable name}, e.g. {neutral/50} refers to the Primitives variable neutral/50.

$notes.text/inverse: Foreground for every solid fill (accent, danger, buy, sell). Fills are chosen so this passes 4.5:1 in both modes.
$notes.selection/row-hover: Hover on a selected row. blue/75 and blue/850 sit between the ramp steps so every text color on rows still passes 4.5:1.
$notes.surface/skeleton: Loading placeholder bars. Decorative: pair with a loading label or aria-busy, never color alone.
$notes.finance: Buy (blue) / Sell (coral) are actions. Gain (green) / Loss (crimson red) are data. Never rely on color alone: pair with B/S labels, +/− signs, and ▲/▼ glyphs.
$notes.status/critical: Shares the crimson red ramp with finance/loss. Destructive (danger) buttons use status/critical, never finance/sell.

$descriptions.surface/background: Page and app background, behind panels.
$descriptions.surface/panel: Background of panels, cards, grid rows, and input fields.
$descriptions.surface/raised: Background of surfaces that sit above the page: menus and dialogs.
$descriptions.surface/hover: Background of a hovered row, cell, menu option, or ghost control.
$descriptions.surface/disabled: Background of disabled controls and fields.
$descriptions.surface/pressed: Background of a pressed secondary or ghost control.
$descriptions.border/default: Dividers and the borders of panels, cards, and grid rows.
$descriptions.border/strong: Borders people need to see to use a control: input fields, checkboxes, chips, and the grid header rule.
$descriptions.text/primary: Main text: values, labels, and headings.
$descriptions.text/secondary: Supporting text: field labels, captions, placeholders, and inactive column headers.
$descriptions.text/disabled: Text and icons in disabled controls. Exempt from contrast minimums.
$descriptions.text/inverse: Text and icons on every solid fill (accent, danger, buy, sell).
$descriptions.accent/default: Primary actions, links, progress bars, and selected controls such as a checked checkbox or the selected tab.
$descriptions.accent/hover: Hover state of accent fills and links.
$descriptions.accent/subtle: Tinted background for accent areas: the bulk action bar, the selected menu option, and the selected tab's count.
$descriptions.focus/ring: The 2px keyboard focus outline on every interactive control.
$descriptions.selection/row: Background of a selected grid row.
$descriptions.selection/row-hover: Background of a selected grid row while hovered.
$descriptions.surface/skeleton: Loading placeholder bars. Decorative, so pair them with a loading label.
$descriptions.status/positive: Positive status (success, ready): icons and borders.
$descriptions.status/positive-subtle: Tinted background for positive status, as in status chips.
$descriptions.status/positive-strong: Text and icons for positive status on its subtle background.
$descriptions.status/warning: Warning status (needs attention): icons, and the border of flagged cells and fields.
$descriptions.status/warning-subtle: Tinted background for warning status: chips and flagged cells.
$descriptions.status/warning-strong: Text and icons for warning status on its subtle background, and the over-target progress bar.
$descriptions.status/critical: Critical status (error, destructive): error icons and borders, and the fill of danger buttons.
$descriptions.status/critical-subtle: Tinted background for critical status: chips and error cells.
$descriptions.status/critical-strong: Text and icons for critical status on its subtle background.
$descriptions.status/info-subtle: Tinted background for informational status, as in status chips.
$descriptions.status/info-strong: Text and icons for informational status on its subtle background.
$descriptions.status/neutral: Neutral status (draft, inactive): icons and borders.
$descriptions.status/neutral-subtle: Tinted background for neutral status, as in status chips and tab counts.
$descriptions.status/neutral-strong: Text and icons for neutral status on its subtle background.
$descriptions.finance/buy: Buy side of an order or trade, which is an action. Never use it for gain.
$descriptions.finance/buy-subtle: Tinted background for the Buy side chip.
$descriptions.finance/buy-strong: Text on the Buy side chip.
$descriptions.finance/sell: Sell side of an order or trade, which is an action. Never use it for loss or for destructive buttons.
$descriptions.finance/sell-subtle: Tinted background for the Sell side chip.
$descriptions.finance/sell-strong: Text on the Sell side chip.
$descriptions.finance/gain: A gain in a value, which is data: the up glyph and signed number in gain cells.
$descriptions.finance/gain-subtle: Tinted background for highlighting a gain.
$descriptions.finance/gain-strong: Gain text and glyph on tinted backgrounds, such as flagged cells.
$descriptions.finance/loss: A loss in a value, which is data: the down glyph and signed number in loss cells.
$descriptions.finance/loss-subtle: Tinted background for highlighting a loss.
$descriptions.finance/loss-strong: Loss text and glyph on tinted backgrounds, such as flagged cells.

spacing.$notes: Spacing scale for gap and padding (scope: Gap), plus corner radii (scope: Corner radius). Published: applied directly in layouts.

$descriptions.space/2: 2px gap or padding, the smallest step.
$descriptions.space/4: 4px gap or padding, for tightly related items such as an icon and its label.
$descriptions.space/6: 6px gap or padding, used by compact controls and cells.
$descriptions.space/8: 8px gap or padding, the default between related items.
$descriptions.space/12: 12px gap or padding, for groups inside a panel.
$descriptions.space/16: 16px gap or padding, for panel padding, screen margins, and grid gutters.
$descriptions.space/32: 32px gap or padding, for generous separation.
$descriptions.space/48: 48px gap or padding, for page-level padding.
$descriptions.radius/xs: 2px corner radius, for very small elements.
$descriptions.radius/sm: 4px corner radius, for controls, chips, and fields.
$descriptions.radius/md: 8px corner radius, for panels, cards, and dialogs.
$descriptions.radius/pill: Fully rounded ends, for pill shapes such as filter chips.

size.$notes: Dimension scale for fixed widths and heights (scope: Width & height). For heights that should follow Density, use Density/* instead.

$descriptions.size/4: 4px fixed width or height, for thin bars such as a progress track.
$descriptions.size/12: 12px fixed width or height, for small icons.
$descriptions.size/16: 16px fixed width or height, for icons and checkboxes.
$descriptions.size/20: 20px fixed width or height. For heights that should follow the Density mode, use Density instead.
$descriptions.size/24: 24px fixed width or height. For heights that should follow the Density mode, use Density instead.
$descriptions.size/32: 32px fixed width or height. For heights that should follow the Density mode, use Density instead.
$descriptions.size/40: 40px fixed width or height, such as the grid's checkbox column. For heights that should follow the Density mode, use Density instead.
$descriptions.size/56: 56px fixed width or height, such as the app bar.
$descriptions.stroke/1: 1px stroke for borders, dividers, and underlines.
$descriptions.stroke/2: 2px stroke for focus rings and other emphasized lines.

density.$notes: Every value is an alias to the Size or Spacing scale — never a raw number.

$descriptions.row/height: Height of grid rows and header cells. Follows the Density mode.
$descriptions.cell/padding-x: Left and right padding inside grid cells. Follows the Density mode.
$descriptions.cell/padding-y: Top and bottom padding inside grid cells. Follows the Density mode.
$descriptions.control/height: Height of buttons, input fields, and menu options. Follows the Density mode.
$descriptions.control/padding-x: Left and right padding inside buttons and input fields. Follows the Density mode.
$descriptions.control/height-sm: Height of small controls, such as small buttons and filter chips. Follows the Density mode.
$descriptions.control/padding-x-sm: Left and right padding inside small controls. Follows the Density mode.
$descriptions.control/gap: Gap between the parts of a control, such as an icon and its label. Follows the Density mode.
$descriptions.icon/size: Width and height of icons inside controls. Follows the Density mode.

Numeric.description: Intended for tabular figures: enable Type settings → Details → Numbers → Style → Monospace uppercase/lining (the plugin API cannot set this).

contrast.$notes: Rules consumed by scripts/contrast-check.mjs. Each rule expands to every foreground × background pair, checked in every Color mode. Levels: body = 4.5:1, large = 3:1 (≥18px regular or ≥14px bold), ui = 3:1 (icons, borders, focus rings), exempt = reported only (disabled content, WCAG 1.4.3 exception).

rules.name: Status text on surfaces (field errors, over-target notes)
Text on pressed surfaces (pressed secondary/ghost buttons, filter chips)
Text on accent-tinted surfaces (selected tab count, bulk action bar)
UI graphics on interactive surfaces (focus ring, borders on hover/pressed and selected rows)
Warning and error cell borders on their tinted backgrounds
Danger icon button glyph (row actions on any row background)
Gain and loss values in warning and error cells
Warning notes on selected rows (Needs sign-off)
Labels on solid fills (buttons, B/S tags)
UI graphics on surfaces (icons, input borders, focus ring)
